hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.terraform/*|*.tfstate*) exit 0;; esac; rel=$(realpath --relative-to="$PWD" "$f" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$rel" in modules/*/*.tf) match=1 ;; *.tf) case "$rel" in */*) match=0 ;; *) match=1 ;; esac ;; *) match=0 ;; esac; [ "$match" = "1" ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Terraform file changed \u2014 check whether docs/ARCHITECTURE.md still reflects this, and whether the change is an architectural tradeoff worth an ADR in docs/decisions/ (see CLAUDE.md)."}}'; exit 0; }
